column1: # Macro renames, old<TAB>new. tools/rename-macros.py applies these to a project.
# Kept as a history: when a macro is renamed in macros.tex, add a line here.
# v0.2.0: capitalise custom macros so they are distinguishable from LaTeX's own.
# v0.2.0: home-made higher-order macros removed in favour of diffcoeff's syntax.
# These change argument order, so rename-macros.py cannot do them; it reports them.
# \arg is reported too, not renamed: it is LaTeX's own operator (\arg(z), with its
# own parentheses) unless a project's old _macros redefined it as \arg{z}, which
# becomes \Arg{z}. Only the source can tell which, so check each one by hand.
